# Og'abek Olimjonov — Frontend Developer

> Junior frontend developer based in Namangan, Uzbekistan. Builds responsive,
> accessible interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js, Next.js and
> Tailwind CSS, and translates Figma designs into production code. Open to
> junior and remote roles. The portfolio is published in Uzbek and English.

## Projects

- [DevCommons](https://devcommons.vercel.app/): a platform for developers to share
  code snippets and prompts. Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS.
  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/devcommons
- [AgroVision AI](https://agro-vision-ai-zeta.vercel.app/): web platform for detecting
  crop diseases from images, aimed at agriculture in Uzbekistan.
  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/agro-vision-ai
- [Faxr Mebel](https://faxr-mebel.vercel.app/): catalogue website for a furniture
  manufacturer.
  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/faxr-mebel
- [Zetra Store](https://zetra-store-one.vercel.app/): e-commerce storefront with
  catalogue and cart. Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS.
  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/zetra-store
- [NexusDevs](https://nexusdevs.vercel.app/): a second personal site presenting
  frontend, AI automation and Telegram bot work, with a short blog.
  Source: https://github.com/OgabekHub/nexus-devs
